name: Shreyas Talpade
bio:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Shreyas Talpade (born 27 January 1976) is an Indian actor who appears in Marathi and Bollywood films.

Description above from the Wikipedia article Shreyas Talpade, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
